scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit suite without the known-defect group (must be green)
scripts-descriptions.test:red: Run only the red tests: group known-defect (registry IDs in the docblocks)
scripts-descriptions.test:all: Run every test, red ones included: --exclude-group replaces the exclusion list of phpunit.xml.dist with a group no test has
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the unit test suite; pass a filter after --, e.g. composer test:unit -- --filter MuxTest
scripts-descriptions.test:watch: Re-run PHPUnit when the content of a .php file in src/ or tests/ changes (CRC32 of the content, not mtime)
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan on src (phpstan.neon.dist, level 9) and on tests (phpstan-tests.neon.dist, level 5)
scripts-descriptions.cs: Check coding style with PHP-CS-Fixer, print the diff, change nothing
scripts-descriptions.cs:fix: Apply PHP-CS-Fixer to the files in .php-cs-fixer.dist.php
scripts-descriptions.check: Run cs, stan and test in sequence; stops at the first failure
